$comment: Shared error code registry. Owner: Agent 0. Other agents request additions via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST.md. Envelope: {"error": {"code", "message", "trace_id", "details?"}}

codes.description: Request body/query failed schema validation. details.fields[] lists offending fields.
Missing, invalid or expired bearer token.
Authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.
Resource does not exist or caller may not know it exists.
Generic state conflict.
Too many requests.
Unexpected server error. trace_id must be present.
A required backing service is unavailable.
User account is disabled in NAIS.
Token org_code does not map to a registered organization.
User's organization membership is disabled.
Role is not valid for this scope or caller cannot assign it.
Operation not allowed on an archived project.
User is already an active project member.
Cannot remove or demote the last PROJECT_OWNER.
User is not a member of the project.
Version is PUBLISHED and cannot be modified.
Operation requires a PUBLISHED version. Shared: used by catalog, governance, readiness.
Publish requested but some files are not uploaded/verified, or no files exist.
Version label already used in this dataset.
The draft is based on an older version than the latest PUBLISHED one; rebase it first.
Upload session expired; create a new one.
Stored object sha256/size does not match manifest.
Media type or extension is not in the allow list.
File exceeds the per-file size limit.
Archive exceeds limits (compression ratio > 100, > 10k entries, or > 20 GiB uncompressed).
Malware scanner reported the object as infected; object deleted.
Dataset policy is inconsistent (e.g. SENSITIVE with max_grant_days > 30).
Transition not allowed from the current request state.
An open request or active grant already exists for the same user/project/dataset.
Purpose is not in the dataset's allowed_purposes.
Requested operation cannot be granted (e.g. WRITE, or COMPUTE in P0).
Requested/approved duration exceeds max_grant_days.
Requester is not an ACTIVE member of the referenced project.
Caller is not a DATA_STEWARD of the dataset owner organization.
Dataset access level does not require a grant (PUBLIC, or INTERNAL for own org).
No active grant for this user/project/dataset.
The access grant has expired.
The access grant has been revoked.
Grant is not ACTIVE (cannot revoke twice).
OPA returned allow=false. details.reasons[] contains policy reason codes.
OPA unreachable or timed out. Fail-closed.
Unknown readiness profile id.
A QUEUED/RUNNING validation already exists for this version and profile.
No validation has been run for this version/profile.
Notification does not exist or belongs to another user.
